questions.option_note: # W/ ELECTRIC CLUTCH FAN W/BCM 4TH GEN

questions.answer: A122J 18GY, to platform/elec panel connector pin 37 (body controller pin E1)

questions.ask: Sur le circuit du lift, le fil B122E monte au fusible B12-A (CH3_12). Dans le tableau des fusibles, c'est combien d'ampères, quelle alimentation, pis ça sert à quoi?

questions.answer: B12-K, rating NOTE 4, IGN, ALTERNATE ENTRANCE DOOR/PTI/AC NOISE SUPPRESION

questions.ask: Sur un bus avec bloc de fusibles MTA, l'interrupteur du power vent arrière prend son alim au fusible B12-V (CH3_23). C'est combien d'ampères et sur quelle alimentation?
questions.answer: B12-V, 7.5 A, NS3 (REAR POWER VENT); the B12-V branch (^B76B) is for vehicles with 0508108 MTA fuse block

questions.ask: The booster pump switch circuit with front mounted heater goes to fuse B3-G (CH3_10). In the fuse table, what is B3-G's rating entry, power source and description?
questions.answer: B3-G, rating NOTE 20, MD1, BOOSTER PUMP

questions.answer: B9-A, POST TRIP INSPECTION, NOTE 7, BAT
